patches.name: Unlock premium
patches.description: Unlocks all AI Plant Doctor premium features by bypassing Google Play Billing. Injects a fake active annual subscription (me.jodoin.aiplantdoctor.premium_annual) into the Flutter in_app_purchase_android Pigeon channel so the app always considers the user a premium subscriber.
